title: Tunisian Cranberry Crumble
description: A sweet and tangy dessert combining the flavors of Tunisia with the freshness of cranberries, topped with a crunchy crumble.

ingredients.name: Fresh or Frozen Cranberries
ingredients.notes: Fresh is preferred for best flavor

ingredients.name: Tunisian Orange Marmalade
ingredients.notes: Can substitute with regular orange marmalade

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the cranberries, orange marmalade, and granulated sugar. Mix well to coat the cranberries evenly.
Transfer the cranberry mixture into a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, combine the flour, cold butter, rolled oats, brown sugar, cinnamon, and salt. Mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Spread the crumble mixture evenly over the cranberry mixture.
Bake for 40-45 minutes or until the topping is golden brown and the filling is bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm, topped with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream if desired.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
